inlines.v: KNIFE, noun nife; plural knives; nives. 1. A cutting instrument with a sharp edge. Knives are of various shapes and sizes, adapted to their respective uses; as table knives; carving knives or carvers; penknives, etc. 2. A sword or dagger.
